overview: Inngest is an event-driven durable functions platform. This package self-hosts the Inngest server with bundled PostgreSQL 17 and Redis 7 for reliable background jobs and workflows.
description:
Inngest is a durable execution platform for event-driven background jobs and workflows. It receives events through an Event API, schedules and queues function runs, and executes steps with automatic retries, fan-out, batching, throttling, and cancellations. A built-in dashboard lets you inspect apps, functions, events, and run history.

This package self-hosts the single-node Inngest server with bundled PostgreSQL 17 for system data and run history and Redis 7 for the queue and run state. The main container runs `inngest start`; the dashboard and API are published on port 8288 and the Connect WebSocket gateway on port 8289. Event ingestion and app sync are secured with the packaged `INNGEST_EVENT_KEY` and `INNGEST_SIGNING_KEY`.

Typical use cases include durable background jobs, event-driven automation, reliable step workflows, scheduled tasks, and self-hosted workflow orchestration for applications built with the Inngest SDKs.
